digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and agent-lifecycle instrumentation
propositions: Rebar has no aggregation layer or command to query agent-driven dev-loop trends over time despite maintaining rich event-sourced history
Tier-C blindspots (env/integration diagnosis intervals, bug provenance, bug classification outcome) leave no durable trace in the event store and cannot be derived structurally
Blame-based caused_by auto-derivation must bypass the closed-source guard by writing directly to _links to avoid silent failure when a bug link source is already closed
Bug-close transition must replace the required free-text reason argument with a bounded --class enum persisted on the STATUS event without increasing required argument count
The rebar metrics command must report all registered metrics across a date range with either a value or an unavailable state carrying reason and accrual timestamp
Backfilled classified data must be labeled source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified and never aggregated into authoritative structural series
